data.title: LUM1NAR Tower
data.about:
LUM1NAR Tower is a project from the developer Object One Real Estate Development. The elegant building consists of three towers with a height of 25 residential floors, located in the popular Jumeirah Village Triangle neighborhood. 

Every corner of LUM1NAR is a testament to modern sophistication and charm, where every moment is imbued with wonder and beauty. Frosted glass panels, softly lit from within, greet with a shimmering embrace, combining the warmth of wood. There are 1 and 1.5 bedroom apartments for sale. The interiors are contemporary in style with beautiful hues, creating a cozy atmosphere and have thoughtful layouts with spacious cozy rooms.

Premium world-class amenities for residents include a gym, swimming pool with lounge area, children's pool, children's playroom, outdoor playground, yoga studio, sauna, and barbecue area. Also provided, the technology of the future, the system "Smart House". In walking distance are shopping centers, schools, kindergartens, medical facilities, cafes and restaurants.
